items.search.title: Search Items
items.search.description: Tool to search items (products and bundles) with advanced filtering. Use when you need to find items by specific criteria (name, product_type, archived status, etc.) using complex queries.

include.description: Comma-separated list of relationships to include (e.g., 'photo,tax_category').

page_size.description: Number of items per page. If not specified, server default is used.

page_number.description: Page number to retrieve, must be >= 1.

fields_items.description: Comma-separated list of item fields to return (e.g., 'id,name,product_type,sku'). If not specified, all fields are returned.

orders.search.title: Search Orders
orders.search.description: Tool to search orders with advanced filtering using logical operators. Use when you need to find orders by specific criteria (status, dates, customer) with complex queries like date ranges or multiple conditions.

include.description: Comma-separated list of relationships to sideload (e.g., 'customer,lines,plannings').

page_size.description: Number of orders per page. If not specified, server default is used.

page_number.description: Page number to retrieve, must be >= 1.

fields_orders.description: Comma-separated list of order fields to return (e.g., 'id,number,status,customer_id'). If not specified, all fields are returned.

filter_conditions.description: Filter conditions with logical operator for order search.

plannings.search.title: Search Plannings
plannings.search.description: Tool to search plannings with advanced filtering. Use when you need to find planning records by specific criteria using complex queries with logical operators.

fields.description: Field selection specification for controlling response fields.

include.description: Comma-separated list of relationships to include (e.g., 'product', 'bundle', 'location', 'order').

page_size.description: Number of plannings per page. If not specified, server default is used.

page_number.description: Page number to retrieve, must be >= 1.

filter_conditions.description: Filter conditions with logical operator for advanced search.

companies.update.title: Update Company
companies.update.description: Tool to update the current company's information in Booqable. Use when you need to modify company details such as name, contact information, address, or billing settings.

billing_email.description: Billing email address (if different from main email)

address_line_1.description: First line of the company address

address_line_2.description: Second line of the company address (optional)

use_billing_address.description: Whether to use a separate billing address
